newsitem.title: USA: PERRY TO COHEN: Take care of the troops.
newsitem.headline: PERRY TO COHEN: Take care of the troops.

text.p: Outgoing U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry had some advice for his expected successor, William Cohen, on Monday: "Take care of the troops and they will take care of you."

Perry was asked in a CNN interview what advice he would give Cohen, a retiring Republican senator from Maine who will appear before the Senate Armed Services Committee in a confirmation hearing on Jan. 22.

"When I took this job, the sergeant major of the Army gave me some advice which stuck in my mind," Perry responded. "He said, 'take care of your troops and your troops will take care of you.' I took that advice to heart and I tried very hard to follow it."
Perry said Cohen as secretary would have to focus on how to maintain the readiness and competence of U.S. forces in case they were called upon to serve anywhere at any time.

"The key to that, as I said, is take care of the troops and they will take care of you," added Perry, who in three years as secretary has pushed improvements in pay, housing and other "quality of life" issues for troops and their families.
